exercises.explanationUz:
SURATLAR:
  A - bayroq silkitayotgan odamlar
      (Yaponiya)
  B - kashtali kostyum va sharfli
      odamlar karnay chalmoqda
  C - kechasi yorug' aravalar
      (floats)
  D (93-bet) - katta rangli varrak


JAVOBLAR:
  1 Japan
  2 a kite festival
  3 embroidered costumes; scarves
  4 people banging drums - B;
    a colourful kite - D;
    brightly-coloured floats - C;
    people waving flags - A


⚠ 'A KITE':

  = varrak.
  ⚠ 'to fly a kite' = varrak
  uchirmoq.


⚠ 'EMBROIDERED':

  = kashtali.
  ⚠ 'embroidery' = kashta.


⚠ 'A COSTUME':

  = kostyum (milliy/festival kiyimi).
  ⚠ 'suit' = kostyum (rasmiy).


⚠ 'A SCARF / SCARVES':

  = sharf, ro'mol.
  ⚠ Ko'plik 'scarves' - 'f' → 'v'.


⚠ 'TO BANG DRUMS':

  = nog'ora urmoq.


⚠ 'A FLOAT':

  = bezatilgan arava (festival).


⚠ 'TO WAVE FLAGS':

  = bayroq silkitmoq.

exercises.instructionUz: Suratlardagi odamlar maskarad bazmiga bormoqda. Ularga qarang va kim bo'lib borayotganini (sayyoh, ofitsiant ayol, detektiv, uchuvchi, gangster, maktab o'quvchisi qiz) va nima kiyganini ayting, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'A is going to the fancy-dress
   party as a waitress. She's
   wearing a blue uniform with an
   apron, black tights and flat
   black shoes.'


KIYIMLAR (suratdagi yorliqlar):

  A - WAITRESS: apron (fartuk),
      uniform (forma), tights
      (kolgotka), flat shoes (poshnasiz
      tufli)
  B - TOURIST: straw hat (somon
      shlyapa), shirt (ko'ylak),
      Bermuda shorts (uzun shortik),
      trainers (krossovka)
  C - GANGSTER: suit (kostyum), tie
      (galstuk), hat
  D - DETECTIVE: coat (palto), cloak
      (plash), waistcoat (nimcha),
      trousers (shim)
  E - PILOT: leather jacket (teri
      kurtka), scarf (sharf),
      breeches (uchuvchi shimi), boots
      (etik)
  F - SCHOOLGIRL: jacket (pidjak),
      skirt (yubka), socks (paypoq)


⚠ 'A FANCY-DRESS PARTY':

  = maskarad bazmi (kostyumli).


⚠ 'TO GO AS':

  = ... bo'lib bormoq.
  'She's going AS a waitress.'


⚠ 'TIGHTS':

  = kolgotka. Ko'plik shaklda.


⚠ 'TRAINERS':

  = krossovka (BrE).
  ⚠ AmE 'sneakers'.


⚠ 'A WAISTCOAT':

  = nimcha. /ˈweɪskəʊt/.


⚠ 'A CLOAK':

  = plash (yengsiz).


⚠ 'BREECHES':

  = kalta shim (uchuvchi/otliq).

exercises.instructionEn: The Kite Battles
exercises.instructionUz: Varrak janglari
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

1) Yaponiyaning Hamamatsu shahriga
tashrifimni hech qachon unutmayman.
May boshida borishga qaror qildim -
mahalliy odamlar varrak festivalini
o'tkazadigan vaqt. Har yili 3-5 may
oralig'ida mahalliy odamlar
bolalariga sog'liq, kuch va jasorat
keltirish uchun rangli varraklar
uchiradi. Yo'lda Hamamatsu varrak
festivali tarixi haqida biroz
o'qidim. Aftidan, hammasi taxminan
430 yil oldin, viloyat hukmdori
bolasining ismi yozilgan ulkan
varrakni osmonga uchirganida
boshlangan.

2) U yerga festival boshlanishidan
bir necha kun oldin kelganimda,
tayyorgarliklardan hayratda qoldim.
Ba'zi odamlar ulkan varraklar
yasardi, boshqalar yorqin rangli
aravalarni bezash bilan band edi.
Qayerga bormay, katta festival uchun
tayyorlanayotgan tort va shirinliklar
hidini sezardim. Ularni tatib
ko'rishga sabrim chidamasdi!

3) Festivalning birinchi kuni osmon
ulkan rangli varraklar bilan to'ldi.
Shunchalik hayajonlandimki, osmondan
ko'z uzolmasdim. "Jangning maqsadi, -
deb tushuntirdi bir chol, - sovrin
yutish emas, balki jamoalar boshqa
jamoalar varraklarini osmondan urib
tushirib, mahoratini ko'rsatishi." U
menga har bir jamoa yaqinda birinchi
farzand ko'rgan oila uchun varrak
uchirayotganini ham aytdi. Har bir
jamoa turli kostyumda ekanini
payqadim - ularga varraklaridagi
naqshlarga mos murakkab naqshlar
kashta qilingan edi. Ular boshlariga
sharf o'rashgan va qo'llarini varrak
iplaridan himoya qilish uchun qo'lqop
kiyishlari kerak edi. Varrak
jamoalari asosan erkaklar edi, lekin
yuzlab ayollar va bolalar tadbirni
tomosha qilishga kelgan edi. Muhit
ajoyib edi, atrofimda odamlar
to'xtovsiz bayroq silkitar, nog'ora
urar, karnay chalar va hushtak
chalardi. Shu bilan birga, jamoalar
raqiblarining varraklarini g'azab
bilan yerga tortardi. Shunday ajoyib
tomosha ko'rsatganlari uchun ulardan
hayratlanmay ilojim yo'q edi.

4) Festivalning oxirgi kechasi shahar
markazida sayr qilish va aravalarni
tomosha qilish menga juda yoqdi.
Odamlar ularni yasashga aql bovar
qilmas darajada mehnat sarflagan va
ular chindan go'zal edi. Ertasi kuni
Tokioga jo'nab ketishimni o'ylash
meni xafa qildi, lekin varrak
festivali xotiralari men bilan abadiy
qolishini bilardim.


QALIN SO'ZLAR:

  strength = kuch
  courage = jasorat
  lord = hukmdor, bek
  region = viloyat, mintaqa
  huge = ulkan
  preparations = tayyorgarliklar
  enormous = ulkan
  aim = maqsad
  noticed = payqadim
  elaborate designs = murakkab
    naqshlar
  strings = iplar
  teams = jamoalar
  event = tadbir
  furiously tugging = g'azab bilan
    tortmoqda
  opponents = raqiblar
  stunning show = ajoyib tomosha
  memories = xotiralar


⚠ 'APPARENTLY':

  = aftidan, aytishlaricha.


⚠ 'TO BE AMAZED AT':

  = ...dan hayratda qolmoq.


⚠ 'I COULDN'T WAIT TO':

  = sabrim chidamasdi.


⚠ 'TO TAKE ONE'S EYES OFF':

  = ko'z uzmoq.


⚠ 'TO SHOW OFF':

  = ko'z-ko'z qilmoq, ko'rsatmoq.


⚠ 'TO KNOCK OUT OF':

  = urib tushirmoq.


⚠ 'TO MATCH':

  = mos kelmoq.


⚠ 'KEPT + -ING':

  = to'xtovsiz ... qilardi.


⚠ 'I COULDN'T HELP + -ING':

  = ...masdan ilojim yo'q edi.


⚠ 'TO PUT ON A SHOW':

  = tomosha ko'rsatmoq.


⚠ 'AN INCREDIBLE AMOUNT OF':

  = aql bovar qilmas miqdorda.


⚠ 'FOREVER':

  = abadiy.

tasks.en: The Kite Battles
tasks.uz: Varrak janglari

tasks.en: I'll never forget my visit to the Japanese city of Hamamatsu. I decided to go at the beginning of May, when the local people have their kite festival.
tasks.uz: Yaponiyaning Hamamatsu shahriga tashrifimni hech qachon unutmayman. May boshida borishga qaror qildim - mahalliy odamlar varrak festivalini o'tkazadigan vaqt.

tasks.en: Every year, between 3rd and 5th May, the local people fly colourful kites to bring their children good health, strength and courage.
tasks.uz: Har yili 3-5 may oralig'ida mahalliy odamlar bolalariga sog'liq, kuch va jasorat keltirish uchun rangli varraklar uchiradi.

tasks.en: On the way there I read a little about the history of the Hamamatsu Kite Festival. Apparently, it all started about 430 years ago, when the lord of the region sent a huge kite into the sky with his child's name on it.
tasks.uz: Yo'lda Hamamatsu varrak festivali tarixi haqida biroz o'qidim. Aftidan, hammasi taxminan 430 yil oldin, viloyat hukmdori bolasining ismi yozilgan ulkan varrakni osmonga uchirganida boshlangan.

tasks.en: When I arrived there, a few days before the beginning of the festival, I was amazed at the preparations involved. Some people were making enormous kites, while others were busy decorating brightly-coloured floats.
tasks.uz: U yerga festival boshlanishidan bir necha kun oldin kelganimda, tayyorgarliklardan hayratda qoldim. Ba'zi odamlar ulkan varraklar yasardi, boshqalar yorqin rangli aravalarni bezash bilan band edi.

tasks.en: Everywhere I went I could smell cakes and sweets cooking, ready for the big festival. I couldn't wait to try them!
tasks.uz: Qayerga bormay, katta festival uchun tayyorlanayotgan tort va shirinliklar hidini sezardim. Ularni tatib ko'rishga sabrim chidamasdi!

tasks.en: On the first day of the festival, the sky was filled with huge, colourful kites. I was so excited that I couldn't take my eyes off the sky.
tasks.uz: Festivalning birinchi kuni osmon ulkan rangli varraklar bilan to'ldi. Shunchalik hayajonlandimki, osmondan ko'z uzolmasdim.

tasks.en: "The aim of the battle," explained an old man, "is not to win a prize, but for the teams to show off their skills by knocking the other teams' kites out of the sky."
tasks.uz: "Jangning maqsadi, - deb tushuntirdi bir chol, - sovrin yutish emas, balki jamoalar boshqa jamoalar varraklarini osmondan urib tushirib, mahoratini ko'rsatishi."

tasks.en: He also told me that each team was flying a kite for a family who had recently had their first child.
tasks.uz: U menga har bir jamoa yaqinda birinchi farzand ko'rgan oila uchun varrak uchirayotganini ham aytdi.

tasks.en: I noticed that every team had different costumes, which were embroidered with elaborate designs to match the ones on their kites. They wore scarves around their heads and they had to wear gloves to protect their hands from the kite strings.
tasks.uz: Har bir jamoa turli kostyumda ekanini payqadim - ularga varraklaridagi naqshlarga mos murakkab naqshlar kashta qilingan edi. Ular boshlariga sharf o'rashgan va qo'llarini varrak iplaridan himoya qilish uchun qo'lqop kiyishlari kerak edi.

tasks.en: The kite teams were mostly men, but hundreds of women and children had come to watch the event. The atmosphere was fantastic, and all around me people kept waving flags, banging drums, playing trumpets and blowing whistles.
tasks.uz: Varrak jamoalari asosan erkaklar edi, lekin yuzlab ayollar va bolalar tadbirni tomosha qilishga kelgan edi. Muhit ajoyib edi, atrofimda odamlar to'xtovsiz bayroq silkitar, nog'ora urar, karnay chalar va hushtak chalardi.

tasks.en: At the same time, the teams were furiously tugging their opponents' kites to the ground. I couldn't help admiring them for putting on such a stunning show.
tasks.uz: Shu bilan birga, jamoalar raqiblarining varraklarini g'azab bilan yerga tortardi. Shunday ajoyib tomosha ko'rsatganlari uchun ulardan hayratlanmay ilojim yo'q edi.

tasks.en: On the last evening of the festival, I really enjoyed walking around the city centre and watching the floats. People had put an incredible amount of work into making them and they were really beautiful.
tasks.uz: Festivalning oxirgi kechasi shahar markazida sayr qilish va aravalarni tomosha qilish menga juda yoqdi. Odamlar ularni yasashga aql bovar qilmas darajada mehnat sarflagan va ular chindan go'zal edi.

tasks.en: It made me feel sad to think that I would leave for Tokyo the next day, but I knew that the memories of the kite festival would stay with me forever.
tasks.uz: Ertasi kuni Tokioga jo'nab ketishimni o'ylash meni xafa qildi, lekin varrak festivali xotiralari men bilan abadiy qolishini bilardim.

exercises.instructionEn: Unforgettable Moments
exercises.instructionUz: Unutilmas lahzalar
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

1) Rok konsertiga borganmisiz? Men
o'tgan shanba Bath yaqinidagi
Pinecrest jamoat bog'ida bo'lgan
konsertga bordim, va u ajoyib edi.
Bu olti xil guruh, jumladan sevimli
guruhim The Runners ishtirokidagi
kun bo'yi davom etgan tadbir edi.

2) U yerga yetib borganimda ertalab
soat to'qqiz edi, shuning uchun ular
ovoz tizimi uchun karnaylarni
o'rnatishini tomosha qildim. U yerda
ishlayotgan erkaklardan biri hatto
mendan yordam so'radi, shuning uchun
yugurib borib unga yordam berdim.

3) Konsert soat o'n birda boshlandi,
va oldin yordam berganim uchun
sahna chetida o'tirishga ruxsat
berishdi. Men ijrochilarga qo'l
tekkizish mumkin bo'lgan darajada
yaqin edim. Men uchun konsertning
eng yaxshi qismi The Runners
chiqqanda edi. The Runners'ning
asosiy xonandasi Eddie Easton kumush
gitarasini ushlab chiqqanida
ishonmadim. Sevimli xonandamga
shunchalik yaqin bo'lganimdan juda
hayajonlandim. Hamma qarsak chala
boshladi. Eddie to'g'ri mening
oldimda to'xtadi, egildi va menga
tomoshadan bahramand bo'lishimni
aytdi. Keyin barcha xitlarini kuylay
boshladi. Hammamiz unga qo'shildik va
musiqaga raqsga tushdik. Konsertning
qolgan qismi go'zal edi va hamma
ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdi.

4) Uyga piyoda qaytarkanman, holdan
toygan, lekin ayni paytda sevimli
guruhimni ko'rish va besh ming odam
oldida Eddie bilan gaplashish imkoni
bo'lganidan juda xursand edim.


SARLAVHALAR:
  Place/Date of Concert → 1
  Before the Concert → 2
  During the Concert → 3
  Writer's Feelings → 4


QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  public park = jamoat bog'i
  set up = o'rnatmoq
  sound system = ovoz tizimi
  edge = chet
  performers = ijrochilar
  hits = xitlar (mashhur qo'shiqlar)
  delighted = juda xursand


⚠ 'INCLUDING':

  = jumladan.


⚠ 'SINCE' (bu yerda):

  = chunki (sabab), 'beri' emas!
  'since I had helped' = yordam
  berganim uchun.


⚠ 'TO BE ALLOWED TO':

  = ruxsat berilmoq.


⚠ 'CLOSE ENOUGH TO':

  = ... uchun yetarli yaqin.


⚠ 'TO APPEAR':

  = paydo bo'lmoq, chiqmoq.


⚠ 'RIGHT IN FRONT OF':

  = to'g'ri oldida.
  ⚠ 'right' = aynan.


⚠ 'THE REST OF':

  = qolgan qismi.


⚠ 'EXHAUSTED':

  = holdan toygan.


⚠ 'HAD HAD':

  = past perfect: 'I had had the
  chance' - imkon bo'lgan edi.

tasks.en: Unforgettable Moments
tasks.uz: Unutilmas lahzalar

tasks.en: Have you ever been to a rock concert? I went to one last Saturday at Pinecrest, a public park near Bath, and it was fantastic. It was an all-day event with six different bands, including The Runners, my favourite group.
tasks.uz: Rok konsertiga borganmisiz? Men o'tgan shanba Bath yaqinidagi Pinecrest jamoat bog'ida bo'lgan konsertga bordim, va u ajoyib edi. Bu olti xil guruh, jumladan sevimli guruhim The Runners ishtirokidagi kun bo'yi davom etgan tadbir edi.

tasks.en: It was only nine o'clock in the morning when I got there, so I watched as they set up the speakers for the sound system. One of the men working there even asked me to help, so I ran over and gave him a hand.
tasks.uz: U yerga yetib borganimda ertalab soat to'qqiz edi, shuning uchun ular ovoz tizimi uchun karnaylarni o'rnatishini tomosha qildim. U yerda ishlayotgan erkaklardan biri hatto mendan yordam so'radi, shuning uchun yugurib borib unga yordam berdim.

tasks.en: The concert started at eleven o'clock, and since I had helped earlier I was allowed to sit at the edge of the stage. I was almost close enough to touch the performers. The best part of the concert for me was when The Runners appeared.
tasks.uz: Konsert soat o'n birda boshlandi, va oldin yordam berganim uchun sahna chetida o'tirishga ruxsat berishdi. Men ijrochilarga qo'l tekkizish mumkin bo'lgan darajada yaqin edim. Men uchun konsertning eng yaxshi qismi The Runners chiqqanda edi.

tasks.en: I couldn't believe it when Eddie Easton, The Runners' lead singer, walked out holding his silver guitar. I felt very excited to be so close to my favourite singer. Everyone started clapping. Eddie stopped right in front of me, leaned over, and told me to enjoy the show.
tasks.uz: The Runners'ning asosiy xonandasi Eddie Easton kumush gitarasini ushlab chiqqanida ishonmadim. Sevimli xonandamga shunchalik yaqin bo'lganimdan juda hayajonlandim. Hamma qarsak chala boshladi. Eddie to'g'ri mening oldimda to'xtadi, egildi va menga tomoshadan bahramand bo'lishimni aytdi.

tasks.en: Then he started singing all of his hits. We all joined in with him and danced to the music. The rest of the concert was wonderful, and everybody had a great time.
tasks.uz: Keyin barcha xitlarini kuylay boshladi. Hammamiz unga qo'shildik va musiqaga raqsga tushdik. Konsertning qolgan qismi go'zal edi va hamma ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdi.

tasks.en: Walking home, I felt exhausted, but also delighted that I had had the chance to see my favourite band and talk to Eddie in front of five thousand people.
tasks.uz: Uyga piyoda qaytarkanman, holdan toygan, lekin ayni paytda sevimli guruhimni ko'rish va besh ming odam oldida Eddie bilan gaplashish imkoni bo'lganidan juda xursand edim.

tasks.en: Before the festival, people make enormous kites, decorate brightly-coloured floats and cook cakes and sweets.
tasks.uz: Festivaldan oldin odamlar ulkan varraklar yasaydi, yorqin rangli aravalarni bezaydi va tort va shirinliklar pishiradi.

tasks.en: During the festival, the teams have kite battles and try to knock the other teams' kites out of the sky. People wave flags, bang drums, play trumpets and blow whistles. On the last evening, people walk around the city centre and watch the floats.
tasks.uz: Festival davomida jamoalar varrak janglari o'tkazadi va boshqa jamoalar varraklarini osmondan urib tushirishga harakat qiladi. Odamlar bayroq silkitadi, nog'ora uradi, karnay va hushtak chaladi. Oxirgi kechasi odamlar shahar markazida sayr qiladi va aravalarni tomosha qiladi.

tasks.en: The writer was very excited and amazed. He felt sad to leave, but he knew the memories would stay with him forever.

tasks.en: Excuse me. Is there a school near here? How do I get there?

tasks.en: Dear Sally, I'm having a birthday party next Saturday and I'd love you to come.
tasks.uz: Aziz Sally, Kelasi shanba tug'ilgan kunim bazmini o'tkazyapman va kelishingni juda xohlardim.

tasks.en: We're going to have a buffet and my mum is going to bake a big cake. I'm going to blow out the candles, and then we're going to play party games and dance.
tasks.uz: Biz bufet qilmoqchimiz va onam katta tort pishirmoqchi. Men shamlarni puflab o'chiraman, keyin bazm o'yinlarini o'ynab, raqsga tushamiz.

tasks.en: I hope you can make it! Love, Jane
